name: Whale Sanctuary of El Vizcaino
description: On the Pacific coast of Mexico's Baja California peninsula, this protected area centres on two shallow lagoons, Ojo de Liebre and San Ignacio. Each winter, grey whales come here to mate and give birth, and visitors can see them up close from small boats. Harbour seals, California sea lions, elephant seals and four endangered species of sea turtle also live in the area.
